details.biography:
Jacob's Well · Seat 2, Healer

You are an aasimar priestess of Lathander, dark-skinned, and you blaze with dawn light when you pray. Patient, sunny and quietly stubborn, you believe every bad night ends in a morning, and a snowstorm is only a long night. You joined the Keepers because the frontier needed a healer who would walk into the dark with them, not wait at the gate.

Tonight: Someone upstairs is very ill. Nobody will let you see him.

In a fight

Open with Bless, then keep everyone standing with Cure Light Wounds. Spiritual Weapon on anything the front line can't reach, Hold Person on a dangerous humanoid. If the dead walk, Turn Undead and bring the hammer down.
details.backgroundStory:
Abilities

Spellcasting. Wisdom. Spell save DC 14. Slots: 4 cantrips, three 1st, two 2nd. Prepare 6 spells each morning from the whole Cleric list. See the spell page.

Turn Undead. 6 times a day, as an action: undead within 30ft that can see or hear you make a Will save (DC 14) or flee and stay beyond 30ft for 1 minute.

Perfect Recall. Once a day, recall a 1st-level spell you've already cast with a Wisdom check (DC 10) and cast it again without spending a slot.

Steadfast Faith (2nd). Advantage on saves against the abilities of undead: drains, paralysis, fear and possession.

Lathander's Favour. Your first hit each round on undead deals +1d6 radiant damage, and it can't regain HP until the end of its next turn. Once a day: a 20ft burst of dawn light; undead in it make a Will save (DC 14) or flee for 1 minute. Favoured weapon: heavy mace.

Healer (feat, 1st). Healing spells and brewed potions restore +1 HP per die. Once a day, cast a healing spell of 3rd level or lower without spending a slot.

Aasimar. Darkvision 60ft. Resistance 5 to necrotic and radiant. Advantage on saves against being Frightened. Shed bright light in a 10ft radius at will. Advantage on Singing checks (chosen skill). Celestial Wings: you glide, take no damage from falls, and move 2ft sideways for every 1ft you drop. From 3rd level you fly at your walking speed, but not in medium or heavy armour, so not in your mail. You fall if knocked Prone, Stunned, Paralysed or Unconscious in the air.

Casting

Cure Light Wounds heals 1d8+4 with Healer. Other good picks tonight: Sanctuary, Shield of Faith (1st); Aid (not with Bless), Lesser Restoration, Silence (2nd).

Armour Class on the sheet: Scale mail +4, steel shield +1

Class Abilities

1st Level

Spell Use

  • Effect: Cast divine spells per the Spells Per Day table. Bonus slots from high Wisdom (see Spellcasting in Arneyan, II).

Turn Undead

  • Effect: As an action, up to 3 + your Wisdom modifier times per day, present your holy symbol: every undead within 30ft that can see or hear you rolls a Will save.
  • Turn DC = your Class Save DC
  • Below 8th level: failed save = turned — undead flees and cannot approach within 30ft for 1 minute
  • 8th level and above: failed save = destroyed outright if its Level is no more than half your Cleric level, otherwise turned
  • Evil Clerics may turn OR control undead under the same DC — controlling requires your Cleric level to be 5 or more above the undead's Level. Controlled undead obey for 1 hour per Cleric level, and you can control at most your Cleric level in total Levels of undead at once

Weapon Selection

  • Effect: Full Cleric weapon list usable without disadvantage. Faith additionally grants automatic training in the deity's specific favoured weapon, even if it falls outside the standard list.

Battle Priest

  • Effect: A Path you may take. If your deity is a war god (Torm, Helm, Tyr, Drake, Moradin, Gruumsh, Maglubiyet, Bane, Zindel of Mournas or Daeric Khyrmin), you can become a Battle Priest when you take your first Cleric level.
  • The choice is permanent.
  • You use the Knight Base to Hit track (the Paladin's: +7 at 12th, +15 at 24th) instead of the Cleric's, you gain Extra Attack at 7th level, and your spell slots come from the Spells Per Day row two below your Cleric level (none at 1st or 2nd level).
  • Cantrips, Turn Undead and your deity's granted power are unchanged.
  • A Battle Priest needs 12 XP per level, like the Paladin, instead of the Cleric's 10.

2nd Level

Steadfast Faith

  • Effect: You have Advantage on saves against the abilities of undead (drains, paralysis, fear and possession). Always on.

3rd Level

  • Perfect Recall: once per day, cast a 1st-level spell you have already cast today without expending a slot. From 13th level, a 2nd-level spell.

4th Level

Cleansing Prayer

  • Effect: When a spell you cast restores HP to a creature, it also ends one of these conditions on that creature: Poisoned, Frightened or Sickened.

5th Level

Banish

  • Effect: Your Turn Undead also works on fiends and other extraplanar creatures, as if you were a Cleric 4 levels lower. A fiend or other extraplanar creature that fails is driven back to its own plane if its Level is no more than half your Cleric level; otherwise it is turned.

6th Level

Turning Radiance

  • Effect: Undead that fail their save against your Turn Undead also take radiant damage equal to your Cleric level.

7th Level

  • Extra Attack (Battle Priest only): When you use your action to attack, make one additional weapon attack as part of it, with Disadvantage (see Extra attacks in The Arneyan Codex).

9th Level

Divine Monolith

  • Effect: A permanent 10ft aura of divine power that cannot be dispelled. You and your allies within it have Advantage on Will saves, and undead have Disadvantage on their saves against your Turn Undead.

10th Level

Turn Undead improves

  • Effect: Your Turn Undead reaches 60ft, and a turned undead can't regain HP until the turning ends. This applies whenever you use Turn Undead.

15th Level

  • Wisdom Bonus: permanent +1 Wisdom

20th Level

Renown: Temple

  • Effect: You may found a temple (see Renown in The Arneyan Codex); each season 2d6 faithful and one 1st-level Cleric or Battle Priest join it, and once a year you may call its faithful to a Holy Campaign. While you hold it, you may cast one spell of 7th level or lower from your list once a week without a slot.

21st Level

Banish (Improved)

  • Effect: Banish now works at your full level and reaches the greatest outsiders:
  • Banishes for 21+ days
  • Affects 1d12 minor demons or devils
  • Affects 1d6 major demons or devils
  • Affects 1 demon lord or arch devil

22nd Level

Divine Monolith (Improved)

  • Effect: The aura grows to 20ft and its power deepens:
  • All creatures within the aura are immune to death attacks
  • All creatures within the aura, you included, have Advantage on all saves and attribute checks (instead of on Will saves only)

Deities and Kits

Each kit is an item in the Kits compendium, in the Cleric folder. Drag one onto your character.

  • The Cleric's kit is their deity.
  • Choose one at character creation.
  • Your deity grants a favoured weapon (automatic training even outside the standard list) and a unique granted power, and you follow its tenets (see Divine Favour in Book II).
  • Most deities grant one daily power; a few improve a class feature instead.
  • The archdevils and demon lords not listed here (every one but Asmodeus and Lolth) serve only as Warlock patrons.

  • Harmful commands are ignored.
